Can't kill what you can't touch.|[[Crysta Markon]], to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:TBT">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Balmorran Target|the D5-Mantis}}</ref>}}
'''Ivernus''' was [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who served as the the supreme commander of the Imperial forces on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|He's a war hero, all right. Actually won some battles against the Mandalorians. Wonder if that's how he got on the list?|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="TOR:TBT" />}}
Admiral Ivernus was an intelligent officer who commanded the respect of his inferiors. He managed the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|fighting]] from a distance, preoccupied with the Empire's other conflicts, but watched with a keen eye. Ivernus was awarded the Empire's highest medal for planning Balmorra's initial invasion, and in spite of the ensuing quagmire, had continued to rise in esteem,<ref name="TOR:AI">{{TORcite|type=codex|Admiral Ivernus}}</ref> never leaving his ship in Balmorra's orbit.<ref name="TOR:TBT" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Admiral Ivernus was designated as a target of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] attributed to a [[Hunter (individual)|young bounty hunter]]. The hunter thanks to [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] was able to determine a weak link through Major [[Pirrell]],<ref name="TOR:TBT" /> who was looking for help to discredit his superior and gain the favor of Ivernus.<ref name="TOR:PA">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Pirrell's Ambitions|Balmorra}}</ref> He had the Hunter run jobs across Balmorra to that effort, ultimately succeeding in bringing Ivernus away from the protection of his warship. But much to Pirrell's surprise, Ivernus was looking to execute him for his incompetence, before Pirrell's [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] slave, [[Murghir]], was revealed to be a rival bounty hunter after Ivernus. The Hunter was able to kill both Murghir and Ivernus at the same time.<ref name="TOR:MtA" />
{{GameDSmechanics}}
The Hunter then chose to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Pirrell when he attempted to escape.<ref name="TOR:MtA" />
